sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: ⏱ millisecond Length toggle: an active filter on the Length column — or a global filter for a length value — kept its old answer after pressing the toggle. Filtering "." then switching to milliseconds still showed no rows although every length now read e.g. "3:11.666"; filtering ".666" in milliseconds and switching back to seconds still showed the row, now reading "3:12". The toggle now makes every active filter re-test the new text.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: CLAUDE.md: the millisecond-precision notes now name all three caches the toggle must drop, and why. DEBUG-NOTES.md: dated root-cause entry with the fixture results and mutation outcomes.
